1.mascotDialogue: Nothing fancy here, beta! Just compare your neighbor, swap if you are bigger, and repeat the whole sweep until nothing needs swapping anymore. Simple, simple.

2.mascotDialogue: `n minus i minus 1` on line 3, beta — that shrinks the inner loop's range every single pass. The last i elements are already sorted, so why check them again? No need.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar creep one step right, beta, every single swap it loses — that is the 'bubbling' this whole algorithm is named after, made completely literal for you.

4.mascotDialogue: This one will not crash every time, beta — that's the sneaky part! It will just occasionally read garbage past the array, and that is exactly the kind of bug that slips by, because it does not always announce itself.
